# Menubar

> A row of Menus, such as File, Edit and View, with the arrow keys to move between them. It's the APG's menubar.

`<slab-menubar>` · Navigation · built on `[role=menubar]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/menubar/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/menubar.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-menubar label="Editor">
  <slab-menu label="File">
    <button slot="anchor">File</button>

    <slab-menu-item>New</slab-menu-item>
    <slab-menu-item>Open…</slab-menu-item>
  </slab-menu>

  <slab-menu label="Edit">
    <button slot="anchor">Edit</button>

    <slab-menu-item>Undo</slab-menu-item>
    <slab-menu-item>Redo</slab-menu-item>
  </slab-menu>
</slab-menubar>
```

Each Menu in it is an ordinary [Menu](menu.md), with its own `label`, anchor and Menu Items. To do something when a Menu Item is chosen, listen for its "click". Disable a Menu by disabling its anchor.

## Keyboard

| Key                | What it does                                                                                    |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Left, Right        | On an anchor, moves to the previous or next anchor, wrapping and skipping disabled ones.        |
| Home, End          | On an anchor, moves to the first or last anchor.                                                |
| Enter, Space, Down | On an anchor, opens its Menu at the first Menu Item.                                            |
| Up                 | On an anchor, opens its Menu at the last Menu Item.                                             |
| Left, Right        | In an open Menu, closes it and opens the previous or next Menu, wrapping and skipping disabled. |
| Up, Down           | In an open Menu, moves to the previous or next Menu Item.                                       |
| Escape             | Closes the open Menu and returns focus to its anchor.                                           |
| Tab                | Closes the open Menu and leaves the menubar. Coming back, focus returns to the last anchor.     |

## Elements

### `<slab-menubar>`

Import `slab-elements/menubar.js` to register it.

A menubar with no visual styles: a row of Menus, such as File, Edit and View, each opened from its anchor, with the arrow keys to move between them.

It's the APG's menubar. Each Menu's anchor becomes a `[role=menuitem]` in a `[role=menubar]`, and Tab reaches the menubar once. The rest is the Menu's own: Enter, Space and Down open it at its first Menu Item, Up at its last, and Escape closes it.

Exactly one anchor is tabbable: the one most recently focused or opened, or the first that isn't disabled. Left and Right move focus between the anchors, wrapping at each end and skipping disabled ones, and Home and End go to the first and last. While a Menu is open, Left and Right close it and open the one beside it instead, and pointing at another anchor does the same, as a desktop menubar does. In a right-to-left page, Left and Right swap.

Style it through its part, each Menu through its own, and the anchors directly.
